newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt overnight and one-week rates slip.
newsitem.headline: Egypt overnight and one-week rates slip.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound narrowed on Thursday in a liquid end-of-week market to 9-3/4 and 10 percent from Wednesday's 9-3/4 and 10-1/4 percent, private sector bankers said.
One-week rates also fell to 9-3/4 and 10-1/8 percent from 10 and 10-1/4 percent on Wednesday, they said.
Several bankers said they did not deal in overnight or weekly rates due to slack demand.
Public sector banks held minimum overnight lending rates at 10-1/2 percent.
